utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club might be meeting later this week. I should ask Eli if they picked the next book yet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, but I can ask at the meeting on Thursday. I’ll bring a short list of options so we can decide quickly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Thursday works for me. I’ll look forward to the list and help narrow it down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, book club. What time was it again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It starts at 7. I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you at 7.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the book club is still on for Thursday, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, as far as I know it still is. I just want to make sure we’ve got the time and place set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, Thursday works for me too. Can you confirm the time and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I think I still have the title somewhere. What were we reading again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think it was the one by Atwood, if I’m remembering right.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, Atwood. I’ll check my shelf when I get home and bring the title next time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Noah, can you remind me which book club meeting you mean? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the one next Tuesday at the library. I think it was about that mystery novel we picked, unless that changed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, next Tuesday at the library for the mystery novel meeting, unless anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, what did I miss about the book club?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You missed the part where we picked the next book and set the meeting for Thursday evening. I can catch you up on the rest after that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, what book did you pick?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus. I can bring a couple of good options for the next book club pick.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Sam. I’m happy to hear what you both pick, and I can bring my chair if we need one more spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds perfect, Gus. I’ll bring a couple of options and we can see what fits best.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet where the book club is meeting, but I can keep track if you tell me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, I’ll let you know once I have the meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, keep me posted and I’ll track the place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club’s got a good one this month, from what I heard. I’ll bring you the details when I see the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Nice, send it my way when you get the flyer. I’m in for the next one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, I’ll send it over as soon as I get that flyer.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for book club tonight, and what book are we discussing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I’m still in for tonight. We’re discussing *The Midnight Library*.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring my copy. See you tonight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can ask around and see who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with a couple people and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, let’s keep the book club moving. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet and we can pick a date that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good, Rosa. I’ll do my best to make it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Uli. I’ll note that you’re planning to come, and I’ll send the final date once everyone weighs in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking a pretty lively one this month, so I’d be ready for opinions.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and I heard they’re leaning toward something with a bit of debate in it, so it should be a good night for swapping opinions.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late again. What did I miss with the book club?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not much, just the next book and a date for the meeting. I can fill you in after if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, fill me in after. Just tell me the book and when we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t joined book club yet, but I’m curious what you’ve been reading.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly classics lately. I can tell you if you want, but I’m not very talkative about it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A little. Which classics have you liked most lately?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can make it Tuesday if that works.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Tuesday works for me. What time should I bring the book club notes?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: How about 7 PM? Bring the notes then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I heard the book club is picking a new novel soon. Want me to ask around and see what people are excited about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please do. I’d like to hear what people are actually excited about before I decide.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’ll ask around and see what people are genuinely excited to read.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the book club. I think we were reading that mystery one, unless that changed too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think so, unless someone changed it again. I can check which mystery it was if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, check it if you can. I keep losing track of which mystery it is.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting got moved to Thursday this week.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh good, that gives me one less thing to juggle this week.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to join the book club if you need one more person.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, that gives us the last spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can come, but I’ll need the exact time and address so I can plan my route.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, it’s at 7:30 PM at 214 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I’ll plan to be there at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club is meeting Thursday evening at my place if you want to come. I can send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, I’d like that. Send me the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send them over right now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make the book club meeting work, as long as it doesn’t land on a school pickup night. What day were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: How about Tuesday evening? I think that should stay clear of pickup night.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Tuesday evening works for me if it really stays clear of pickup. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell. I’ve got the book club list ready, and I can help make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks, Rosa. Just let me know what I should tell folks about the book club plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll tell folks the book club meets as planned and remind them to bring their book and any notes for a good discussion.
